what: Clicking a photo raises a black backdrop to .5 over .15s linear. Once it is fully up, the window (a .4 tinted panel) turns on from transparent over .15s linear while dropping in from 50px above over .3s ease-out — Bootstrap 5 modal fade. Closing via the close button (top right ×), outside the window or Esc turns the window off over the same length while moving up, and then the backdrop clears over .15s. While open, page scroll is locked and focus goes to the close button, and on close it returns to the photo that was clicked

options.fade: Duration of the curtain and window turning on and off (seconds), default .15 — 0 is instant
options.drop: Top distance (px) where the window starts to descend, default 50
options.tint: Tint opacity of the window panel itself, default .4 — combined with the veil, the actual darkness is 1 − (1 − veil)(1 − tint)
options.label: Window aria-label, default ”View larger”
options.--fx-width·--fx-top: Window width · top margin (via style), default 62vw · 5vw (below 992px the width is 100% − 32px)
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Cell to view larger on press — the inner [data-fx-part=Clones media] or the first child and puts it in the window. The description is data-caption
options.fx:open·fx:close: Event fired from the element on open and close (detail.item of fx:open is the tapped cell). Fire fx:close-modal on the element to close it

use: …
note: The original is a Bootstrap 5.3.3 modal (MIT) — the site bundle (sticky-toc-foundation-article) uses _vendor/bootstrap@5.3.3 as it is, and the parts were rewritten without the library in the same order (backdrop → dialog, and dialog → backdrop when closing) and with the same values (.fade .15s linear · .modal-dialog translate(0,-50px) .3s ease-out · backdrop .5 · dialog panel rgba .4). The dialog layer is attached inside an element, so if any ancestor of that element has a transform or filter, fixed gets trapped inside that ancestor.

from.where: index.html .mf-fig (photo pairs, topic figures and support diagrams in activity detail — original figure[data-bs-toggle=modal] → .modal.fade, window width 62vw · top 5vw · close × top −40px)
